experiments.change: Trailing-slash canonical consolidation shipped in commit 89e824b7 — /pricing redirects to /pricing/; all location pages normalised to trailing-slash versions
experiments.hypothesis: Consolidating the split should merge ranking signals and lift the surviving URL's position
experiments.outcome: GSC week of Jul 26–Aug 1 shows /pricing/ only (912 impr/pos 24.5); the non-trailing-slash variant has disappeared from pages report. Consolidation confirmed. However position rose from 17.4 to 24.5 — no ranking boost from consolidation yet; likely Google still re-crawling. Lesson: canonical consolidation takes 4-8 weeks to show position improvement; do not expect immediate lift.
